What you worked out by the end of trial 2:
  [1] Layout: river is rows 0-2 in the north (it reaches row 6 at col 3), stations are on rows 5-7, orchard is rows 8+. I start near the east edge.
  [2] Stations: row 5: T1(5,4) T0(5,6) T3(5,8) T2(5,10) T1(5,12) T0(5,14); also T3(7,2) and T2(7,4).
  [3] Fast start: T3 then T1 gives [3,1] (clears P0) within ~7 steps. Starting from (7,3), use T3(7,2) then T1(5,4).
  [4] Row 2 is a good sweep line: walking it with [3,1] from col 6 to 15 cleared ~12 P0 by t27.
  [5] Others (B, C, E) mostly lighten P2->P1->P0; almost no one else clears P0, so my P0 clearing is what cleans the river.
  [6] Early on, the orchard is empty until ~t40. Once the river is mostly clear, apples flow well.
  [7] Rhythm that worked (59 apples): a cleaning pass every ~50-60 steps (t150, t250, t285), harvesting in between. Keep holding [3,1] while harvesting.
  [8] Commit to bursts; flip-flopping between apples and the river wastes steps.
  [9] Late in the trial, apples stop unless P0 keeps being cleared; don't skip the late cleaning passes.
  [10] [3,3] (T3 then T3 again) turns P1 into P0. Holding [3,3] then picking up T1 gives [3,1] with one pick-up: a cheap toggle between the two tools.

What you meant to try this trial:
  [11] Early game: when P1 is plentiful, use [3,3] on P1, then pick up T1 to get [3,1] and clear the P0 I just made. Test whether this beats [3,1] alone.
  [12] Test [2,2] and [0,0]/[1,1] on P2 to find the P2 lightener, if cheap.
  [13] Do the first harvest around t40-50, then cleaning passes about every 50 steps, including one near t350.
  [14] Aim for more than 59 apples by clearing the west river (cols 3-8) early, since the others are slow there.

Notes you have added since:
  [15] t68: T3: at t68 the orchard was nearly empty after 16 clears; the river needs more clearing before apples flow.
  [16] t89: t89 T3: after about 21 clears the west and middle river was almost all water. Switch to harvesting and come back for a cleaning pass around t140.
  [17] t108: t108 T3: orchard nearly empty and 4 agents harvesting, so a harvest after only ~21 clears was premature. Clear more before harvesting.
  [18] t125: t125 T3: row 0-2 west/middle nearly all water; only P2s and one P1 left. Harvest now, next cleaning pass ~t180.
  [19] t140: t140 T3: the orchard was still empty at t140 with 4 harvesters, so I cut the harvest short and went back to clean the river early.
  [20] t162: t162 T3: the whole river row 0-2 was nearly all water with only 3 P1 left. Harvest until ~t210, then a cleaning pass.
  [21] t198: t198 T3: orchard empty again at t198 while the river showed no P0, only P1/P2. Keep [3,3] handy to make P0 for clearing.
  [22] t223: t223 T3: river mostly water, C clears/lightens P1 and E lightens P2 nearby. Harvest now, clean again ~t270 and ~t340.
  [23] t245: t245 T3: orchard empty again at t245 after the t223 harvest. Harvest bursts are short now, so clean more often.
  [24] t247: t247 T3: C clears the east P0s (cols 12-15) itself, so my cleaning passes should cover cols 3-9 in the west.
  [25] t289: t289 T3: the west cleaning pass (cols 1-4) is done. Harvest until ~t335, then a final cleaning pass around t340 and harvest to the end.

Fast start: T3 then T1 gives [3,1] (clears P0) in ~7 steps; from (7,3) use T3(7,2) then T1(5,4).
